title: knautia montana subsp. involucrata
intro: Knautia montana subsp. involucrata, commonly known as Shepherd's Needle, is a plant species within the Caprifoliaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Knautia montana subsp. involucrata include its expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in relieving cough and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
